title: Asteroids Survivor telemetry event
description: Updated 2026-09-16 for the XP & skill progression slice (docs/Plans/2026-09-16-execution-spec-xp-skill.md), extending the same-day wave-1 core loop update (docs/Plans/2026-09-15-lets-deliver-next-increment.md). Same four event names; adds world_x/world_y to upgrade_chosen and makes session_id persist across browser close (see docs/security/2026-09-16-xp-skill-review.md). Every client event sent via navigator.sendBeacon() to VITE_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT MUST validate against this schema. No changes after 2026-09-16 without a new plan.

session_id.description: Opaque random id (UUID v4). Persisted in IndexedDB and stable across browser close so the upgrade-pick to next-session-start funnel is measurable. Not a name, email or account id.

event_name.description: Closed set for the wave-1 retention probe.

properties.description: Event-scoped numeric/boolean/string facts only. No free text, no user-supplied content, no identifiers.

returning.description: session_start: true when IndexedDB already holds a previous run.

wave_number.description: wave_cleared: the wave number that was just cleared.

upgrade_id.description: upgrade_chosen: id of the upgrade the player claimed.

world_x.description: upgrade_chosen: ship x position (play-field coords) at pick time.

world_y.description: upgrade_chosen: ship y position (play-field coords) at pick time.

duration_ms.description: session_end: milliseconds survived on the run that just ended.

high_score_ms.description: session_end: best survived duration stored in IndexedDB.
